performance.verdict: Meta CPL is healthy; Google burns $507 with zero conversions — structural, not cyclical.

findings.text: Google Ads has spent $506.90 over 28 days with zero conversions — not a bad week, a structural attribution or campaign failure.
Meta carries all 138 leads at $15.79 CPL; last 3 days (Sep 9–11) averaged 7.3 leads/day vs prior 3 (Sep 6–8) at 5.3 — trend is accelerating.
5 overdue milestones (earliest Jul 20): Stripe QA, GHL build gaps, end-to-end stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch — all unresolved per SOW.
GHL shows 134 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments — 138 leads are entering the pipeline and stalling completely inside CRM.
GBP direction requests spiked to 53 over 28 days but produced only 1 call and 1 web click — local intent is real but not converting to contact.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion tracking immediately — $506.90 spent, 0 conversions recorded in 28 days.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $506.90 over the last 28 days and recorded zero conversions — this is almost certainly a pixel or goal misconfiguration, not a campaign failure. Audit the conversion action setup in Google Ads and confirm the tag is firing on the thank-you or call-complete event. Success is confirmed when at least one test conversion registers in Google Ads within 72 hours. Pause Google spend above the minimum floor until tracking is verified — do not scale a blind channel.

suggestions.text: Raise Meta daily budget by +15% — CPL $15.79 is holding and 3-day lead rate just improved from 5.3 to 7.3 leads/day.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta is delivering 138 leads at a $15.79 CPL over 28 days and the last 3-day window (Sep 9–11) shows 7.3 leads/day versus 5.3 in the prior 3 days — momentum is real. Raise the Meta daily budget by 15% from its current level. Success check: CPL remains at or below $18 and daily lead pace holds at 6+ leads/day over the next 5 days. Re-evaluate by Sep 17.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL intake — 134 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments booked; leads are arriving but stalling post-entry.
suggestions.monday_update: 138 leads have entered GHL over 28 days producing 134 opportunities, but zero appointments and zero won deals — the pipeline is a dead end right now. This aligns with the overdue end-to-end stack re-test (due Aug 31) and unverified BWS/Stripe paths flagged in the SOW. Nacer should run one end-to-end test order through each intake path and confirm the automation sequence fires (Becklar, Shippo, follow-up). Success is at least one opportunity progressing past the first stage and one appointment booked within 7 days of fix.
